description: Vertical tabs with 'expand sidebar on hover': the content area reflows for about one frame when the sidebar collapses.
expected_report: With vertical tabs collapsed and expand-on-hover enabled, hovering the sidebar expands it over google.com; moving the cursor away collapses it.
